# Bluewick IT — Quote for Juniper Lane Dental

**Prepared for:** Mary Major, Office Manager  
**Validity:** 30 days from issue  
**Currency:** USD; taxes excluded

## Summary and recommendation

Replace the **10 staff workstations**, reuse existing monitors, install business-grade networking and three Wi-Fi access points, implement encrypted backups with a test restore, and provide monthly support for **11 users**.

The survey identified **12 PCs**, not 10. The two operatory imaging PCs are **not included for replacement**: SensorView v6 requires vendor-certified hardware and vendor sign-off.

The full project is **$18,847.50**, plus recurring services. Including the first annual firewall subscription, the initial commitment is **$19,267.50 before tax**—above the approximately $15,000 budget.

**Recommendation:** Phase the workstation replacements. Install networking and backups now and replace six staff PCs initially. This costs **$14,052.50 including the first annual firewall subscription**, before tax and monthly services. Prioritize backup protection: the last successful backup was four months ago.

## Scope

- Supply and deploy 10 business PCs: i5, 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD.
- Migrate user data and configure existing, licensed applications; reuse monitors.
- Install a business firewall, 24-port managed PoE switch and three access points.
- Configure staff/guest Wi-Fi separation and appropriate network access controls.
- Install a backup appliance and encrypted cloud backup; configure monitoring and perform a documented test restore.
- Include the practice-management database in backup scope, using an application-consistent method confirmed with its vendor.
- Provide managed support for 11 users under a separate service agreement.
- Bluewick will sign a BAA; the cloud backup vendor also signs a BAA. These measures **support the practice’s HIPAA obligations** but do not replace its policies, risk assessment or workforce responsibilities.

## One-off costs — full project

| Item | Quantity | Unit price | Amount |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Business PC | 10 | $960.00 | $9,600.00 |
| Wi-Fi access point | 3 | $350.00 | $1,050.00 |
| Firewall appliance | 1 | $640.00 | $640.00 |
| 24-port managed PoE switch | 1 | $720.00 | $720.00 |
| Backup appliance | 1 | $1,200.00 | $1,200.00 |
| **Hardware subtotal** | | | **$13,210.00** |
| PC deployment/data migration: 2.5 hours per PC | 25 hours | $125.00 | $3,125.00 |
| Network installation | 10 hours | $125.00 | $1,250.00 |
| Backup setup and test restore | 6 hours | $125.00 | $750.00 |
| Project management: 10% of $5,125 labour | 1 | $512.50 | $512.50 |
| **Labour and project management subtotal** | | | **$5,637.50** |
| **Total one-off project** | | | **$18,847.50** |

## Recurring costs

| Service | Quantity | Unit price | Monthly charge | Annual charge |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Managed support | 11 users | $95/user/month | $1,045.00 | — |
| Encrypted cloud backup | 1 | $150/month | $150.00 | — |
| Firewall security subscription | 1 | $420/year | — | $420.00 |
| **Totals by billing frequency** | | | **$1,195.00** | **$420.00** |

**Annualized recurring total:** $14,760.00, comprising 12 monthly payments plus the annual subscription.

**Full-project initial commitment:** $19,267.50, comprising the one-off project and first annual firewall subscription. Monthly services are additional.

## Budget option — recommended phased rollout

| Phase | Included work | One-off cost |
|---|---|---:|
| **Phase 1: Protect and stabilize** | All networking and backup work; six staff PCs, selected by condition and business priority | **$13,632.50** |
| **Phase 2: Complete refresh** | Remaining four staff PCs, including deployment, migration and project management | **$5,215.00** |
| **Combined project** | Same equipment and deployment scope as full project | **$18,847.50** |

Phase 1 includes **$9,370 hardware**, **31 labour hours at $125 = $3,875**, and **$387.50 project management**.

With the $420 annual subscription, Phase 1 totals **$14,052.50**, leaving **$947.50** of the stated budget before tax. Monthly services remain **$1,195** and are not included in this project budget. If $15,000 must also fund ongoing services, we must revise the plan before acceptance.

This approach addresses the most urgent risks without cutting backup or network protection. Four existing staff PCs and both imaging PCs remain in use initially. Phase 2 pricing is subject to revalidation if ordered after quote expiry.

## Assumptions, exclusions and terms

- Existing cabling, ISP service, power and monitors are suitable. New cable runs, electrical work, ISP charges and replacement monitors are excluded.
- Existing application licences are transferable. New licences, vendor fees, server replacement and imaging-PC replacement are excluded.
- Imaging-PC hardware or software changes require vendor approval. Proprietary imaging faults may require vendor involvement.
- Backup capacity, retention, database compatibility and recovery objectives must be confirmed before ordering. Any required scope change will be priced for approval.
- Existing data must be readable. Historical recovery and remediation of corrupted data are excluded; a new backup cannot recover already-lost information.
- No successful recent backup is assumed. Prioritize a verified backup and restore test before workstation migration.
- Support hours, response targets and detailed coverage will be agreed before service begins.
- **Payment:** 50% of hardware due on acceptance; remaining one-off balance due on completion. For the full project: **$6,605 deposit**, then **$12,242.50**. For Phase 1: **$4,685 deposit**, then **$8,947.50**.
- Firewall subscription billed annually at activation; support and cloud backup billed monthly from commencement.
- Taxes are additional. Changes require written approval. Scheduling and equipment availability will be confirmed on acceptance.

---

## Cover email

**Subject: Juniper Lane Dental — IT refresh and support quote**

Hi Mary,

Attached below is our quote for replacing your 10 staff PCs, improving Wi-Fi and networking, introducing encrypted backups, and supporting your 11 users.

The full project exceeds the $15,000 target. I recommend installing networking and backups now and replacing six PCs first: $14,052.50 including the first annual firewall subscription, before tax. Monthly support and cloud backup are an additional $1,195.

The two imaging PCs should remain unchanged until the imaging vendor approves replacements.

Our most urgent finding is that the last successful backup was four months ago. We recommend prioritizing a verified backup and test restore. Bluewick and the cloud provider will sign BAAs to support your HIPAA obligations.

Please confirm whether your budget excludes ongoing services and whether you prefer the phased approach.

Best,  
John Stiles  
Bluewick IT

---

## Internal note to owner

All hardware list prices fall below our 25% gross-margin minimum. Adjusted sell prices: PCs $960, APs $350, firewall $640, switch $720 and backup appliance $1,200; each meets policy. The full initial commitment exceeds budget by $4,267.50 before tax/monthly services. Recommend six-PC Phase 1. Confirm the budget treatment of recurring fees and taxes. Do not silently include the two imaging PCs: vendor certification/sign-off is required. Escalate the four-month backup gap and verify database backup compatibility, capacity and restore success.
